Load configuration files
- location of model drivers, rds files (containing models), tables of parameter estimates and performance metrics, and figures. 
```{r}
read_properties <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  lines <- lines[grepl("=", lines)]  # only keep lines with key-value pairs
  key_vals <- strsplit(lines, "=")
  props <- setNames(
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 2)),
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 1))
  )
  return(props)
}

# *** paleo_config.properties must be in Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026
#location of this script:
current_path <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
#get path to this project
base_path <- sub("(.*Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026).*", "\\1", current_path)

#open 
config <- read_properties(file.path(base_path, "paleo_config.properties"))

# Extract values from config
drivers_root <- config[["drivers_root"]]
table_root <- config[["table_root"]]
```

----------------------------------------------
Run random forest for Strike Count
----------------------------------------------

```{r}

# ── Define predictor set ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Adjust column names to match your actual df
predictors <- c("precip", "tair", "wind", "rh", "swr", "sp")

# ── Random forest 1: Lightning strike count (rstrike) ─────────────────────────
df_strikes <- df[, c("strike_count", predictors)]
df_strikes <- na.omit(df_strikes)

# Correlation check on a sample
#df_sample <- df_strikes %>% sample_frac(0.1)
#plot(df_sample)

#remove a percent of 0s
zero_indices <- which(df_strikes$strike_count == 0)
num_to_remove <- round(length(zero_indices) * 0.75)
set.seed(42)
rows_to_remove <- sample(zero_indices, num_to_remove)
df_strikes <- df_strikes[-rows_to_remove, ]

# ── Fit ranger twice to get both importance metrics ───────────────────────────

rf_permutation <- ranger(
  strike_count ~ .,
  data        = df_strikes,
  num.trees   = 500,
  importance  = "permutation",
  num.threads = 4
)

rf_impurity <- ranger(
  strike_count ~ .,
  data        = df_strikes,
  num.trees   = 500,
  importance  = "impurity",
  num.threads = 4
)

# ── Extract and combine importance scores ─────────────────────────────────────

imp_mse <- data.frame(
  variable   = names(importance(rf_permutation)),
  importance = importance(rf_permutation),
  metric     = "%IncMSE"
)

imp_purity <- data.frame(
  variable   = names(importance(rf_impurity)),
  importance = importance(rf_impurity),
  metric     = "IncNodePurity"
)

imp_all <- bind_rows(imp_mse, imp_purity)

# Order variables by %IncMSE value (so both panels share the same y-axis order)
var_order <- imp_mse |>
  arrange(importance) |>
  pull(variable)

imp_all <- imp_all |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = var_order))

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Label formatting: IncNodePurity values can be large — use scientific notation
imp_all <- imp_all |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("%IncMSE", "IncNodePurity")))

p <- ggplot(imp_all, aes(x = importance, y = variable)) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = as.numeric(variable)),
    linetype  = "dashed",
    color     = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    shape  = 21,
    size   = 3,
    color  = "black",
    fill   = "white",
    stroke = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ metric,
    scales = "free_x",   # each panel gets its own x-axis scale
    ncol   = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Variable Importance — Strike Count",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),
    panel.border      = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    strip.text        = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title        = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p)

```
